mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE sub_tree AS ( SELECT id, 1 AS depth FROM iam_group WHERE id = #{groupId} AND deleted = FALSE UNION ALL SELECT g.id, st.depth + 1 FROM iam_group g JOIN sub_tree st ON g.parent_id = st.id WHERE g.deleted = FALSE AND st.depth < 64 ) SELECT ug.id, ug.realm_id, ug.user_id, ug.group_id, ug.position_id, ug.is_primary, ug.deleted, ug.created_time, ug.updated_time FROM iam_user_group ug WHERE ug.deleted = FALSE AND ug.group_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM sub_tree) ORDER BY ug.group_id, ug.id
